name: Database Zero to Master
tagline: From querying data to defending database architecture
summary: Kurikulum 42 minggu rekomendasi, 10 level, 40 modul, 120 lesson blueprint. Mastery based; bukan akses terkunci berdasarkan waktu.
target_audience: software engineer yang ingin mendalami backend

tracks.beginner: start l0; no skip of integrity gates
tracks.experienced: optional diagnostic test; may skip foundational concept lessons, never required safety assessments

progression.lesson_complete: semua required activity selesai, test otomatis lolos, refleksi tercatat; bukan hanya menekan Next
progression.module_pass: semua lab wajib lolos AND quiz/checkpoint >=80%
progression.level_pass: semua module pass AND stage assessment >=85%; critical integrity tests 100% pass
progression.master_badge: final score >=85/100, zero critical integrity failures, artifact dan defense lengkap
progression.retake: unlimited with variant datasets and explanatory feedback
progression.hints: 3-tier: arah konsep > petunjuk langkah > worked approach; penalti opsional untuk badges, tidak untuk akses belajar

required_for_every_lesson: interactive task with starter state/SQL and deterministic validation
lesson_authoring_contract.guidance: A lesson is NOT finished if only title/summary/placeholder exists. Keep worked solutions hidden from students until attempt/hint.
